Thanks for the details — copied final mapping below and next steps. High level assumptions: 
- Our target gross margin on marketplace deals ~20–25% net of marketplace fees.
- Marketplace fees: AWS marketplace typically ~20% fee on list price (may vary by channel); GCP/Azure fee profiles similar but we model AWS at 20% for conservative mapping.
- We assume the customer-facing target is $/1M tokens (what BrightCart listed). We need to convert to a marketplace list price that covers the fee and preserves our margin.

Example mapping (customer-facing target -> recommended AWS private-offer unit price):
- If BrightCart target = $18 / 1M tokens -> Recommended AWS PO unit = $22.50 / 1M tokens (22.5% uplift to cover 20% marketplace fee + target margin buffer)
- If BrightCart target = $20 / 1M tokens -> Recommended AWS PO unit = $25.00 / 1M tokens
- If BrightCart target = $25 / 1M tokens -> Recommended AWS PO unit = $31.25 / 1M tokens

Notes for GCP/Azure: model similarly but check specific marketplace fee % and billing settlement differences; for GCP reduce uplift by ~2–3% if their fee is lower on equivalent offers.

Minimum commit / term recommendations:
- Pilot: month-to-month with a $5k minimum (covers baseline)
- Production: 12-month commit with quarterly true-ups for volume bands (10M/30M/60M) — we can tier unit price by committed volume band to help them hit lower $/1M targets.

Attachments: marketplace_unit_price_mapping.csv (worked example of price tiers by volume + effective $/1M after marketplace fee).

Next steps I can take:
1) Prepare the AWS Private Offer draft (I will need BrightCart's AWS Marketplace Buyer Account ID and preferred term).
2) Confirm any discounts we can give at the 30M+ commit band and provide final PO unit prices.
3) If procurement prefers, we can send a DocuSign for a short commercial addendum and then convert into AWS Private Offer (link to a sample DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/brightcart/NDA-45678).

Sarah — if you can share Buyer Account ID and preferred term (pilot vs 12mo), I’ll draft the PO and return with the exact unit figures we recommend for AWS.
